newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU lira talks break for an hour.
newsitem.headline: EU lira talks break for an hour.

text.p: The European Union's Monetary Committee broke up its talks on Italy's re-entry to the exchange rate mechanism on Saturday but are set to resume at 9.30 p.m. (2030 gmt), an EU official said.
The official said the talks could go on until 11.30 p.m. (2230 gmt) or into Sunday.
The committee started the talks, focusing on the Italian currencys exchange rate within the ERM, earlier on Saturday but in the afternoon officials said they had run into difficulties.
They said a meeting of EU finance ministers may be needed to resolve the differences, and sources said the ministers were on stand-by to come to Brussels on Sunday.
